title: Memory access optimization of molecular dynamics simulation software Crystal-MD on Sunway Taihulight

summary.zh: 研究 Crystal-MD 在神威·太湖之光上的访存方式与优化。
summary.en: Studies memory access and optimization of Crystal-MD on Sunway TaihuLight.

title: Parallel optimization of the Crystal-KMC on Tianhe-2

summary.zh: 围绕天河二号上的 Crystal-KMC，开展 MPI、OpenMP 与 MIC 混合并行优化。
summary.en: Explores hybrid parallel optimization of Crystal-KMC on Tianhe-2 using MPI, OpenMP and MIC.

title: Crystal-KMC: parallel software for lattice dynamics monte carlo simulation of metal materials

summary.zh: 提出面向金属材料晶格演化模拟的 MPI 并行软件 Crystal-KMC。
summary.en: Introduces Crystal-KMC, MPI-based parallel software for lattice simulations of metallic materials.

title: Kernel optimization for short-range molecular dynamics

summary.zh: 研究短程分子动力学计算内核的多线程与 SIMD 优化。
summary.en: Studies multithreading and SIMD optimization of short-range molecular dynamics kernels.

title: A data-check based distributed storage model for storing hot temporary data

summary.zh: 针对热临时数据，研究基于 XOR 校验的分布式存储与恢复方法。
summary.en: Studies XOR-checksum-based distributed storage and recovery for hot temporary data.

title: Research and implementation of a distributed transaction processing middleware

summary.zh: 设计 POST 系统，结合数据分区与中间件改善分布式事务处理。
summary.en: Designs POST, combining data partitioning and middleware for distributed transaction processing.

title: Frequency and Similarity-Aware Partitioning for cloud storage based on Space-Time Utility Maximization Model

summary.zh: 研究结合访问频率和数据相似度的云存储划分方法。
summary.en: Studies cloud storage partitioning using access frequency and data similarity.
